tools.description: The workspaces this token reaches: those it was given that its owner still works in, and the owner's own space if it was given that. Start here; every other tool takes a workspaceId of this list.

inputSchema.description: The arguments of a tool that takes none: an empty object.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces

tools.description: The workspace in one answer: its name, who the caller is, and every board, wiki and course they read, with whether they joined it, their role, and for a board the properties its cards take (cardProperties: ids, types, options). Read it before list_cards or save_card.

inputSchema.description: A workspace whose overview or day to read.

tools.title: Workspace overview

tools.description: Up to ten people of the workspace whose login name or name holds q, as the caller sees them (no email): the ids to give a card's people property or mention in Markdown as @[name](fvoci-user://<id>).

inputSchema.description: People to find in a workspace.

q.description:
Text their login name or name holds, in any case; left out, the ten oldest
accounts.

tools.name: find_people
tools.title: Find people

tools.description: Search what the cards, pages and units of the workspace say, by words that a hit's title and body hold together (#12 finds card number 12). Each hit names its container and kind, with a snippet.

inputSchema.description: A search of what a workspace says.

containerId.description: Only what is in this board, wiki or course: the `limit` is of its hits.

kind.description: Only what is of this kind.

limit.description: How many hits at most, 1 to 50; 20 if left out.

q.description:
The words, every one of which a hit's title and body hold together; `#12` finds
the cards numbered 12. At most 200 characters.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.title: Search a workspace

tools.description: One page of a board's cards in short (id, number, title, parent, property values, updatedAt), chosen by title text, parent, assignee, one property's value or a time of change. Property ids and option ids are in get_workspace_overview.

inputSchema.description: The cards of a board to list.

assigneeId.description:
Only the cards given to this person (`me` for the caller), by a property of
people.

parentId.description: Only the sub-cards of this card; `root` for the cards at the top.

perPage.description: How many cards a page has, from 1 to 1000; 50 if left out.

propertyId.description: Only the cards whose value of this property is `propertyValue`; sent with it.

propertyValue.description:
The value `propertyId` is to have: an option's identifier for a select, a
person's for people, the text for text.

sort.description: The order; the oldest first if left out.

oneOf.description: The order cards are listed in.

updatedSince.description:
Only the cards changed at or after this time, in milliseconds since the Unix
epoch.

A card by id, or by containerId and number; a page or unit by containerId and id.

containerId.description:
The board, wiki or course the item is in: needed for a page, a unit, and a card
named by its number.

id.description: The item's identifier. A card is named by it, or by `containerId` and `number`.

kind.description: What the item is: a card, a page or a unit.

number.description: The card's number on its board, as `#12` names it.

containerId.description: The board, wiki or course it is in.

kind.description: What the item is: a card, a page or a unit.

tools.description: What was done to a card, the newest first, a page at a time: its making, each change of its title, of a property's value (as the card stores it: option and person ids, dates), of its parent and of whether it is a template, and its coming back from the trash, each with who did it (actorId) and, for an agent, its token (actorTokenName). One person's changes of one thing within five minutes are one line. Its body's changes are not in it.

inputSchema.description: A card whose activity to read.

perPage.description: How many lines a page has, from 1 to 1000; 50 if left out.

tools.title: Activity of a card

cardId.description:
Only the files this card of the board shows: those its body names and those
attached to it.

tools.title: List files

tools.description: The caller's day in the workspace: their cards due or overdue, units scheduled, reviews due and meetings coming.

inputSchema.description: A workspace whose overview or day to read.

tools.title: Today

tools.description: Make a card on boardId, or change cardId: title, icon, parent, property values, and the body, whole (bodyMarkdown, with readAt; refused while people type in it) or added to (appendMarkdown, which keeps what they type), and how it repeats (recurrence: completed, it makes its next card). Kept as a version by this token, and told to the card's people as the agent's.

inputSchema.description: A card to make or change.

appendMarkdown.description:
Markdown to add after the last of the body, written as one more editor writes:
whoever types in the body meanwhile keeps what they typed. Added after the
other changes. Not with `bodyMarkdown`.

boardId.description: The board to make the card on; left out when `cardId` names one to change.

bodyMarkdown.description:
The whole body in Markdown, written over the body there is: refused while
people may type in it (`room_has_active_editors`), and while it has blocks its
Markdown does not hold (`complex_blocks_use_append`). To change a card's body,
sent with `readAt`. Not with `appendMarkdown`.

cardId.description: The card to change; left out, a card is made.

deletedProperties.description: Properties whose value the card is to lose.

icon.description: The icon: one emoji, or empty for none.

parentId.description: The card it is a sub-card of, on the same board; empty for the top of the board.

properties.description:
Values to set, by property identifier (`cardProperties` of the board in
`get_workspace_overview`): an option's identifier for a select, a list of them
for a multi-select, a list of person identifiers for people, `YYYY-MM-DD` for a
date, text for text, a number for a number, `true` or `false` for a checkbox.
The card's other values stay.

readAt.description:
The `updatedAt` of the card as it was read: the change is refused (409) if the
card changed since. Sent with what is written whole; `appendMarkdown` alone keeps
what changed since and takes none.

recurrence.description:
How the card repeats: `{"every": 1, "unit": "week", "anchor": "due"}` (`every`
1 to 365; `unit` `day`, `week`, `month` or `year`; counted from the due date,
`due`, or from the day it is completed, `done`); `null` makes it stop. When a
card that repeats is completed, the server makes the next card, due one period
on. Only on a board with a rule of done and a named due date property
(`recurrence_needs_board_rules`). Left out, a card that is changed keeps its own.

anchor.description: What the next due date of a card that repeats is counted from.

unit.description: The unit a card repeats by.

title.description: The title to give it; left out, a card that is changed keeps its own.

tools.name: save_card
tools.title: Save a card

tools.description: Set or clear the same property values of 1 to 200 cards of one board at once, all or none: each card changes as save_card with only properties and deletedProperties would change it. Answers the cards in short.

inputSchema.description: Cards of one board to change alike.

boardId.description: The board the cards are on.

cardIds.description:
The cards: 1 to 200 distinct identifiers of cards of the board that are no
templates.

deletedProperties.description: Properties whose value the cards are to lose.

properties.description:
Values to set on each, by property identifier, as `save_card` takes them. The
cards' other values stay.

tools.name: save_cards
tools.title: Change cards alike

tools.description: Make a page of a wiki or a unit (or chapter) of a course, or change one: title, icon, place, and the body, whole (bodyMarkdown, with readAt; refused while people type in it) or added to (appendMarkdown). With progress, records the caller's own progress on a unit: only in a course they joined (403 otherwise).

inputSchema.description: A page or a unit to make or change, or progress on a unit to record.

after.description: Among those of its parent, right after this one; last if left out.

appendMarkdown.description:
Markdown to add after the last of the body, as one more editor writes: whoever
types in it meanwhile keeps what they typed. Not with `bodyMarkdown`.

bodyMarkdown.description:
The whole body in Markdown, written over the body there is: refused while
people may type in it (`room_has_active_editors`), and while it has blocks its
Markdown does not hold (`complex_blocks_use_append`). To change one's body, sent
with `readAt`. Not with `appendMarkdown`.

icon.description: A page's icon: one emoji, or empty for none.

id.description: The page or unit to change; left out, one is made.

kind.description: Whether it is a page of a wiki or a unit of a course.

parentId.description:
Where a new one goes: below this page, or this chapter of the course; at the top
if left out. Not for one that is changed.

progress.description:
The caller's own progress on the unit, recorded after the rest: only in a
course they joined (403 otherwise).

oneOf.description: The caller's own progress on a unit.

lastPosition.description: Where they are in it, in their own words.

readAt.description:
The `updatedAt` of the page or unit as it was read: the change is refused (409)
if it changed since. Sent with what is written whole; `appendMarkdown` alone
keeps what changed since and takes none.

title.description: The title; a new one made without it has none.

unitKind.description: What a new entry of a course is; a unit if left out.

oneOf.description: What a new entry of a course's outline is.

tools.name: save_page_or_unit
tools.title: Save a page or unit

tools.description: Comment on a card, page or unit, in Markdown, as the caller by this token: the comment names the token, and whoever follows the item is told.

containerId.description: The board, wiki or course it is in.

kind.description: What the item is: a card, a page or a unit.

markdown.description:
The comment in Markdown. A person is mentioned as `@[name](fvoci-user://<id>)`
(`find_people` gives the identifier).

tools.title: Post a comment
